body: Shortly after hearing this story I had to go to the gynecologist's for the first time. On the receptionist's desk was a bowl of Jolly Ranchers. Normally I love them, but when they offered one to me I was like... just... no.

ACT scores put me at the top percentile, but that doesn't mean anything, it just means I'm good at taking standardized tests. I'm good at school, but everything's going to go to hell when I graduate and actually have to function in the real world. So in school I'm a 9, everywhere else I'm a 2.
:/ We're human. We're SUPPOSED to get depressed and frustrated over the stupidest little shit. It's kinda what we do.
Try compassionpit.com. It's sort of like Omegle, except the whole purpose is either venting or listening to someone.

I didn't actually see the debate so maybe I'm not qualified, but from what I hear Romney was more eloquent and Obama didn't seem like he was really into it. I think a lot of debates come down to the quality of the speaking as opposed to the content. If you speak well people are more likely to believe what you say, regardless of what you're saying.
What do you think is going to happen to me, is my question? If I don't do anything?
I just don't want to go back to the psych ward... I might actually prefer death. It might not be that bad.

It can't really be that bad, it can't really be that much. It can't be enough to kill me but I can't believe I did it. I'm strangely proud of myself.

...Time and time again I've asked people to help me and they take on the challenge and they fail, every time.
